newsitem.title: USA: Yankee Energy sees end to losses next year.
newsitem.headline: Yankee Energy sees end to losses next year.

text.p: Yankee Energy Systems Inc, which is the parent of both a natural gas distribution and an energy service company, said on Tuesday it expected its losses to be eliminated in the next fiscal year.
But operating losses at its non-utility subsidiaries were expected to continue in the fourth quarter, it said.
Yankee reported a loss of $0.04 per share in the third quarter compared with a profit of $0.17 per share in the year- ago third quarter.
For the nine months ended June 30, Yankee earned $2.10 per share versus $2.59 per share in the comparable period.
The company said in a statement that slightly warmer weather caused earnings to decrease over the nine month period, as did operating losses at its non-utility units.
But it forecast an end to losses next year.

"Delays in bringing new business new business on line and integrating these companies into the Yankee Energy organization have contributed to losses which are expected to be eliminated in the next fiscal year," it said.
Yankee is the parent of natural gas distribution company Yankee Gas Services and Yankee Energy Services, which provides energy-related services.
